result.document_summary: A mid-document portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 5, Art. 2) covering hotel/motel posting and registers, and an AIDS anti-discrimination ordinance, with no text from the page's algorithmic rent-pricing division.
result.notes: Despite the source URL pointing to San Diego's prohibition on anti-competitive automated rent price-fixing (Div. 11, \u00a798.1103), this part of the document contains only unrelated municipal code text (attire and conduct on licensed premises, hotel/motel rate posting and guest registers, AIDS discrimination in housing, employment, business establishments and testing). The housing-discrimination provision (\u00a752.9503) bars discrimination based on AIDS/ARC/ARS status but does not fall within any of the six in-scope categories (not screening restrictions on criminal history or source of income). The posting-of-rates rules apply to transient lodging, not residential rent regulation. No in-scope rule is stated in this part.
